bio: If you hear footsteps upstairs when nobody is home, call me first.

nodes.partnerMessage: Hey {PlayerName}... ever get that cold prickle on your neck like something is standing right behind your chair?

choices.choiceText: Only when I stay up too late staring at screens.
All the time. My room definitely has entity activity.

nodes.partnerMessage: Denial is the first symptom of spiritual static. I have recorded evidence you need to hear.
